dog.description_text:
This pet needs emergency placement. Please click here to go to our emergency placement page for more information.

Riddick needs at risk placement for medical reasons. He is a senior, emaciated dog with diarrhea and anal fissures. It is a painful condition that requires management with medication that we do not have. He is also not absorbing nutrients from his intestines as he should. He needs long term medical management with a local veterinarian to manage his condition.

Riddick came to ACC as a stray, so we don't have much information on him. His finder states that he allowed all handling with them, even interacting with children in the finder's home with no issue. He has allowed all handling by staff in shelter as well. He is looking for a home who can manage his current medical needs and provide him a comfortable place to ride out his senior years.
dog.name: Riddick
